DDL	create table t1(s string, utf8_binary string collate utf8_binary, utf8_lcase string collate utf8_lcase) using parquet
WRITE	insert into t1 values ('Spark', 'Spark', 'SQL')
WRITE	insert into t1 values ('aaAaAAaA', 'aaAaAAaA', 'aaAaAAaA')
WRITE	insert into t1 values ('aaAaAAaA', 'aaAaAAaA', 'aaAaaAaA')
WRITE	insert into t1 values ('aaAaAAaA', 'aaAaAAaA', 'aaAaaAaAaaAaaAaAaaAaaAaA')

WRITE	insert into t1 values ('İo', 'İo', 'İo')
WRITE	insert into t1 values ('İo', 'İo', 'İo ')
WRITE	insert into t1 values ('İo', 'İo ', 'İo')
WRITE	insert into t1 values ('İo', 'İo', 'i̇o')
WRITE	insert into t1 values ('efd2', 'efd2', 'efd2')
WRITE	insert into t1 values ('Hello, world! Nice day.', 'Hello, world! Nice day.', 'Hello, world! Nice day.')
WRITE	insert into t1 values ('Something else. Nothing here.', 'Something else. Nothing here.', 'Something else. Nothing here.'
WRITE	insert into t1 values ('kitten', 'kitten', 'sitTing')
WRITE	insert into t1 values ('abc', 'abc', 'abc')
WRITE	insert into t1 values ('abcdcba', 'abcdcba', 'aBcDCbA')
READ	select rpad(utf8_binary, 8, utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select rpad(s, 8, utf8_binary) from t1
READ	select rpad(utf8_binary collate utf8_binary, 8, s collate utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select rpad(utf8_binary, 8, utf8_lcase collate utf8_binary) from t1
READ	select rpad(utf8_binary collate utf8_lcase, 8, utf8_lcase collate utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select lpad(utf8_binary collate utf8_binary_rtrim, 8, utf8_lcase collate utf8_binary_rtrim) from t1
READ	select rpad(utf8_binary, 8, 'a'), rpad(utf8_lcase, 8, 'a') from t1
READ	select rpad(utf8_binary, 8, 'AaAA' collate utf8_lcase), rpad(utf8_lcase, 8, 'AAa' collate utf8_binary) from t1
READ	select lpad(utf8_binary, 8, utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select lpad(s, 8, utf8_binary) from t1
READ	select lpad(utf8_binary collate utf8_binary, 8, s collate utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select lpad(utf8_binary, 8, utf8_lcase collate utf8_binary) from t1
READ	select lpad(utf8_binary collate utf8_lcase, 8, utf8_lcase collate utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select lpad(utf8_binary collate utf8_binary_rtrim, 8, utf8_lcase collate utf8_binary_rtrim) from t1
READ	select lpad(utf8_binary, 8, 'a'), lpad(utf8_lcase, 8, 'a') from t1
READ	select lpad(utf8_binary, 8, 'AaAA' collate utf8_lcase), lpad(utf8_lcase, 8, 'AAa' collate utf8_binary) from t1
READ	select TRIM(utf8_binary, utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select TRIM(s, utf8_binary) from t1
READ	select TRIM(utf8_binary collate utf8_binary, s collate utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select TRIM(utf8_binary, utf8_lcase collate utf8_binary) from t1
READ	select TRIM(utf8_binary collate utf8_lcase, utf8_lcase collate utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select TRIM(utf8_binary collate unicode_ai, utf8_lcase collate unicode_ai) from t1
READ	select TRIM(utf8_binary collate utf8_binary_rtrim, utf8_lcase collate utf8_binary_rtrim) from t1
READ	select TRIM('ABc', utf8_binary), TRIM('ABc', utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select TRIM('ABc' collate utf8_lcase, utf8_binary), TRIM('AAa' collate utf8_binary, utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select BTRIM(utf8_binary, utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select BTRIM(s, utf8_binary) from t1
READ	select BTRIM(utf8_binary collate utf8_binary, s collate utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select BTRIM(utf8_binary, utf8_lcase collate utf8_binary) from t1
READ	select BTRIM(utf8_binary collate utf8_lcase, utf8_lcase collate utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select BTRIM(utf8_binary collate unicode_ai, utf8_lcase collate unicode_ai) from t1
READ	select BTRIM(utf8_binary collate utf8_binary_rtrim, utf8_lcase collate utf8_binary_rtrim) from t1
READ	select BTRIM('ABc', utf8_binary), BTRIM('ABc', utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select BTRIM('ABc' collate utf8_lcase, utf8_binary), BTRIM('AAa' collate utf8_binary, utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select LTRIM(utf8_binary, utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select LTRIM(s, utf8_binary) from t1
READ	select LTRIM(utf8_binary collate utf8_binary, s collate utf8_lcase) from t1
READ	select LTRIM(utf8_binary, utf8_lcase collate utf8_binary) from t1

READ	select LTRIM(utf8_binary collate unicode_ai, utf8_lcase collate unicode_ai) from t1
